task:
Add a sticky sidebar to property type landing pages (apartments, villas, townhouses, penthouses, etc.)

## Goal
Every property-type page (PropertyTypeLanding component) should have a beautiful, useful sidebar on desktop (lg+) alongside the embedded search results. On mobile it collapses below the search.

## Sidebar sections (in order, top to bottom)
1. Consultation CTA — green gradient card
2. Market Snapshot — fetch from /api/market-stats?type={searchType}
3. Related Guides — fetch from /api/news?limit=4&category=guides
4. Price Range Guide — static from c.stats
5. Newsletter signup — submit to /api/market-report/subscribe

## Layout change
lg:grid lg:grid-cols-[1fr_320px] lg:gap-8 lg:items-start
Left: search slot + FAQ + CTA. Right: sticky sidebar.

## Quality requirements
- Polished as news article sidebar
- All 5 locales (en/ru/ar/zh/vi)
- Server-side fetched in PropertyTypeLanding
- RTL support for Arabic
- Extracted as PropertyTypeSidebar component
- TypeScript must pass
- Commit and push

stages.spec:
Add a sticky desktop sidebar to property-type landing pages, alongside the embedded search. On mobile it stacks below the search content. The canonical, already-shipped, working reference for EVERYTHING here is the news article sidebar — clone its patterns, do not invent new ones.

## Why this will be good
The news sidebar already nails it: a green-gradient consultation CTA, a market snapshot that hides null rows (never shows fake numbers), a thumbnail-first related list, and a newsletter form with proper idle/loading/done/error states. Cloning it gives property-type pages the same world-class feel for free. Production-ready means: snapshot rows hide when data is null (no zeros), newsletter shows success/error inline, guides section hidden when empty, RTL correct for Arabic, sticky on lg without layout shift, works at 320px.

## CANONICAL REFERENCE — read these first, mirror them exactly
1. Sidebar markup + behavior: `src/app/_clients/news/[slug]/NewsDetailClient.tsx`, the `<aside className="lg:sticky lg:top-24 self-start space-y-5 ...">` block (~line 322 onward). It contains, in working form: the green-gradient TrendingUp consultation CTA, the related-articles thumbnail list (w-20 h-16 rounded-lg + date + line-clamp-2 title), the newsletter form (idle/loading/done/error via a `'idle'|'loading'|'done'|'error'` state, POST to `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || ''}/api/market-report/subscribe` with `{email, source}`), and the Market Snapshot IIFE that reads `marketStats?.summary` and hides null rows with a formatK helper. COPY these — same card classes (`rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card p-5`), same sticky aside classes, same gradient hex `linear-gradient(135deg, #0B3D2E, #1A7A5A)`.
2. Server-fetch pattern: `src/app/[locale]/news/[slug]/page.tsx` lines 41-45 — `const r = await serverFetch(serverApiUrl('/api/market-stats')); if (r.ok) marketStats = await r.json();` wrapped in try/catch. Use this EXACT call. Do NOT pass a `?type=` query param unless you confirm the route honors it (the news page passes none and gets the full summary). If you want type-scoped stats, verify against the live API first; otherwise fetch unscoped like news does.
3. Related guides: use `getNews`/`getRelatedNews`-style helpers in `src/lib/api.ts` (they hit `/api/news?limit=...&lang=...`). For guides, fetch `serverApiUrl('/api/news?limit=4&category=guides')` via `serverFetch` (try/catch → []). Confirm the returned shape is `[{_id, slug, title, featuredImage?, publishedAt?}]` before mapping.

## IMPORTANT — endpoints are EXTERNAL Render API, not local Next routes
There is NO local `/api/market-stats`, `/api/news`, or `/api/market-report/subscribe` route in `src/app/api`. These resolve to the external Fastify API via `serverApiUrl()` (server) and `process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL` (client). Using a bare relative path server-side will 404 silently. Always go through `serverApiUrl()`/`serverFetch` for server fetches and `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || ''}` for the client newsletter POST.

## 1. New component: `src/components/PropertyTypeSidebar.tsx`
Props: `{ locale: string; slug: string; searchType: string; c: PropertyTypeLocale; marketStats: MarketStatsData | null; guides: GuideItem[] }`.
Five sections, in order. Hide any section whose data is empty (no empty cards):
  a. Consultation CTA — green gradient card, TrendingUp icon (same treatment as news CTA: `w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-accent/90` icon chip), title/desc/button. Button → `/contact` for en, `/${locale}/contact` otherwise. All copy from messages.json `common.sidebar.*`.
  b. Market Snapshot — clone the news snapshot IIFE. Show only rows with non-null data: avgYield (`.toFixed(1)+'%'`), transactions (formatK with K+/M+ and the coverage/year label logic from news), offPlanShare (`%`), avgPricePerSqft (e.g. `AED 1,250/sqft`). Use the `dl/dt/dd` pattern and `MARKET SNAPSHOT` label key. If zero rows, render nothing.
  c. Related Guides — thumbnail (w-20 h-16 rounded-lg) + title (line-clamp-2) + date, linking to `/news/[slug]` (locale-prefixed for non-en). Use `ImageWithFallback` like the news list. Label `GUIDES & INSIGHTS`. Render only if guides.length > 0.
  d. Price Range Guide — derive 3 lines from `c.stats` (already on the page; each stat has `{label, n}`). Format each as a readable line (e.g. `Studio · from 350K`). Label `PRICE GUIDE`. Render only if c.stats.length > 0.
  e. Newsletter — clone the news newsletter form verbatim (Bookmark icon header, email input, gradient submit, idle/loading/done/error). Source string: `property-type-${slug}`. Full translation, success/error states.
The newsletter sub-section needs `"use client"`. The whole sidebar is fine as one client component, OR keep PropertyTypeSidebar a server component and extract only the newsletter into a `PropertyTypeSidebarNewsletter` client child — DEV's call; match whatever keeps types clean.

## 2. Modify `src/components/PropertyTypeLanding.tsx` (already an async server component)
- At top of the component, server-fetch both, each in try/catch defaulting to null/[]: market stats via `serverFetch(serverApiUrl('/api/market-stats'))` → `.summary`; guides via `serverFetch(serverApiUrl('/api/news?limit=4&category=guides'))` → array.
- After the hero+highlights+areas block, restructure the search + FAQ + bottom-CTA region into a two-column grid on lg: `<div className="lg:grid lg:grid-cols-[1fr_320px] lg:gap-8 lg:items-start">` — left column holds the existing searchSlot + FAQ + bottom CTA; right column is `<aside className="lg:sticky lg:top-24 self-start space-y-5 ...">` with `<PropertyTypeSidebar .../>`. Match the news aside's sticky + max-h + hidden-scrollbar classes.
- Keep the existing `max-w-5xl` container width unless the 320px sidebar forces a slightly wider main wrapper — if so, widen the grid wrapper only, don't change the hero.
- On mobile (default), the aside naturally flows BELOW the main column — no extra work, just don't force it above.
- RTL: the page already sets `dir={isRtl ? 'rtl' : 'ltr'}`. The grid + sticky must read correctly in RTL (sidebar flips to the left edge automatically under `dir=rtl`). Verify on `/ar/apartments`.

## 3. Translation keys — add to ALL 5 locales (messages/en.json, ru.json, ar.json, zh.json, vi.json)
Place a `sidebar` object inside the top-level `common` namespace. Keys (translate values per locale; keep label keys SHORT/uppercase-friendly):
consultTitle, consultDesc, consultCta, marketSnapshot, avgYield, transactions, offPlanShare, pricePerSqft, guidesLabel, priceGuideLabel, newsletterTitle, newsletterDesc, newsletterEmail, newsletterCta, subscribedSuccess, subscribeError.
Use the same Arabic/Russian/Chinese/Vietnamese tone as existing `common` strings. Numbers/currency follow design system (AED prefix, thousand separators).

## 4. TypeScript
- `MarketStatsData = { avgYield?: number; transactions?: number; transactionsYear?: number; transactionsCoverageMonths?: number; offPlanShare?: number; avgPricePerSqft?: number }` (this is the `.summary` shape).
- `GuideItem = { _id: string; slug: string; title: string; featuredImage?: string; publishedAt?: string }`.
- Newsletter state typed `'idle' | 'loading' | 'done' | 'error'`.
- `npx tsc --noEmit` MUST pass clean.

## 5. Acceptance criteria (user-visible outcomes)
- On `/en/apartments` at lg+, a sticky sidebar sits right of the search; scrolling the page keeps it pinned until its content ends.
- Snapshot shows ONLY real numbers; if the API returns nulls, those rows vanish (never `0%` or fake values). If all null, the snapshot card is absent.
- Guides section appears only when guides exist, with real thumbnails (not placeholder icons).
- Newsletter submit shows loading → success message (or inline error on failure) without page reload.
- At 320px and on `/ar/apartments` (RTL) nothing clips or overlaps; on mobile the sidebar sits below the search.
- No new floating/fixed element added (WhatsApp FAB already exists — don't add a 4th).

## 6. Quality bar
Match or exceed the news article sidebar. Same card styles, same sticky behavior, same polish. Reference DESIGN_SYSTEM.md: brand green gradient verbatim, gold accent for labels, `rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card p-5` cards, uppercase tracked section labels, warm second-person copy, AED-prefixed numbers.

## Interaction matrix
- New server fetches × existing PropertyTypeLanding render → both wrapped in try/catch; page must render fully even if API is down (sidebar sections simply hide).
- New 2-col grid × existing searchSlot embed → searchSlot currently sits in a full-bleed `border-t bg-muted/20` band; moving it into the left grid column must preserve its own internal layout. If the search client expects full width, keep it visually comfortable inside `1fr` — verify it doesn't squash.
- Newsletter POST × existing news newsletter → same endpoint `/api/market-report/subscribe`; only the `source` value differs (`property-type-${slug}`). No new backend work.

## Edge cases
- Empty: API down or empty → each section hides; page still complete (hero, highlights, areas, search, FAQ, CTA all unaffected).
- Locale: all 5 locales get keys; missing-key fallbacks must not show raw key strings — verify ru/zh/ar/vi render translated labels.
- Failure: newsletter network fail → inline error text, form stays usable for retry.

## Commit and push after tsc passes and the demoPath renders.

contextGaps.missing: /api/market-stats, /api/news, and /api/market-report/subscribe are EXTERNAL Render (Fastify) endpoints, NOT local Next.js routes (there is no src/app/api route for them). Server-side: use serverFetch(serverApiUrl('/api/...')). Client-side: POST to ${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || ''}/api/.... A bare relative path server-side 404s silently.

/api/market-stats returns { summary: { avgYield, transactions, transactionsYear, transactionsCoverageMonths, newSupplyUnits, newSupplyYear, offPlanShare, avgPricePerSqft, yoyGrowth? } }. The news detail page fetches it with NO ?type= query param. Whether ?type= scopes the result is unverified — do not assume it does.

The canonical premium sidebar pattern (consultation CTA + market snapshot with null-row hiding + thumbnail related list + newsletter idle/loading/done/error form) lives in src/app/_clients/news/[slug]/NewsDetailClient.tsx in the <aside lg:sticky lg:top-24> block. Clone this for any new sidebar rather than building from scratch.

PropertyTypeLanding.tsx did NOT use next-intl in-file — it relied on inline locale ternaries (locale === 'ru' ? ... ). To pull message-file strings in a server component without request-locale context, use getTranslations({ locale, namespace }) (the explicit-locale form), not the bare getTranslations(namespace). PropertyTypeLanding receives locale as a prop, so the explicit form is required.

PropertyTypeLanding was a synchronous server component; adding server fetches required changing it to `export default async function`. Its page wrappers (src/app/[locale]/{apartments,villas,...}/page.tsx) already await it via JSX so no caller change was needed.

/api/market-stats summary includes offPlanShare and avgPricePerSqft (numbers) in addition to avgYield/transactions/transactionsYear/transactionsCoverageMonths. Format avgPricePerSqft as `AED ${Math.round(n).toLocaleString()}` and offPlanShare as `${n.toFixed(0)}%`.

ImageWithFallback (src/components/ImageWithFallback.tsx) is a default export; its internal FALLBACK is /assets/amenities-placeholder.webp. The news sidebar passes its own FALLBACK_IMAGE=/assets/dubai-hero.webp as the src default before the component's onError fallback kicks in.
